versions.subject: cisco secure firewall detections - first batch
versions.detection:
`cisco_secure_fw` EventType=* SSL_CertFingerprint=*
| lookup sslbl_ssl_certificate_blacklist_lookup SHA1 as SSL_CertFingerprint OUTPUT Listingdate, Listingreason
| where isnotnull(Listingreason)
| stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
        values(InitiatorIP) as initiators
        values(ResponderIP) as responders
        values(Listingreason) as reasons
        values(Listingdate) as dates
        count by SSLCertFingerprint
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_secure_firewall__blacklisted_ssl_certificate_fingerprint_filter`
